account: Tumaini Microfinance (case study from the deck)

findings.title: Departed employee brian.former still has an active key
findings.evidence: the account remains usable by whoever holds the key
findings.fix: Disable the user and its keys now, then review CloudTrail for its use

findings.title: Root user has no MFA
findings.evidence: root account can sign in with a password alone
findings.fix: Enable MFA on root, then store the credentials offline

findings.title: Root user has an active access key
findings.evidence: key AKIA-ROOT-0001 created 2140 days ago, last used 14 days ago
findings.fix: Delete the root access key; nothing should call AWS as root

findings.title: group Developers can escalate its own privileges
findings.evidence: 9 path(s): iam:PassRole + lambda:CreateFunction; iam:PassRole + ec2:RunInstances; iam:CreatePolicyVersion + * and 6 more. For example, create a function that runs as a more privileged role.
findings.fix: Remove one side of each pair, or add a permissions boundary and an SCP

findings.title: shared-loans-1 has no MFA
findings.evidence: console or API access without a second factor
findings.fix: Enforce MFA, then require it in policy with aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent

findings.title: shared-loans-1 is shared by 8 people
findings.evidence: CloudTrail records the user, never the human
findings.fix: Issue one identity per person, or federate to remove IAM users entirely

findings.title: shared-loans-2 has no MFA
findings.evidence: console or API access without a second factor
findings.fix: Enforce MFA, then require it in policy with aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent

findings.title: shared-loans-2 is shared by 4 people
findings.evidence: CloudTrail records the user, never the human
findings.fix: Issue one identity per person, or federate to remove IAM users entirely

findings.title: Group Developers carries AdministratorAccess
findings.evidence: members: shared-loans-1, shared-loans-2, amina, brian.former — full control of the account
findings.fix: Replace with a scoped policy; keep admin in a break-glass role with MFA and alerting

findings.title: Role loan-app-function has a wildcard allow
findings.evidence: Action '*' or a service wildcard with Resource '*'
findings.fix: Scope the action and the resource ARN to what the workload uses

findings.title: shared-loans-1's key is 410 days old

findings.fix: Rotate the key; better, remove it and use a role
